terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A parked vehicle prop: an exterior shell with no interior geometry, since a prop kit is only ever looked at from outside and the glazing is authored as a tinted, mostly opaque pane. The wheels are the mechanisms: each is a named pivot on its axle. Nothing else moves and nothing attaches, so there are no sockets. The other dominant Thai pickup: a green double cab (two full doors a side, B-pillar at 0.45 L), a wide chrome-surrounded grille between clear lamps over a grey bumper, chrome side steps, black flares, steel wheels, mud on the lower doors and a dark open bed.

reasoning: The identity is the side profile -- bonnet, raked screen, double cab and open bed -- and it is one closed polygon swept across the width, with the wheel arches cut into it as notches, then narrowed above the belt for tumblehome. One geometry carries the whole shell.
One repetition system: four wheels off one lathe, each a named pivot on its axle.
A colour difference is not a material difference: every trim tone -- tyre, rim, bumper, lamp -- is a vertex colour on one white material, and the paint carries its dirt as a canvas.
Action readiness is the wheels: four hinge pivots, convex collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: A vehicle cannot be a box on a box: the raked screen, the tumblehome and the arches are what make it read at prop distance, and all three come from shaping one extrusion. The glasshouse is a second extrusion of the cab polygon offset 6 mm proud so no pane shares a plane with the body. The bed is open, so its walls, bulkhead and tailgate are boxes merged into the same shell. SECOND PASS: the sweep is subdivided 14 across the width and FILLETED -- a 0.13 m shoulder along the fender and roof edges, a 0.24 m plan radius at the nose and 0.06 at the tail -- width columns biased to the edges so the arc has four segments, with angle-limited (50 deg) smooth normals, so the bonnet crowns, the roof corners round and the nose wraps instead of meeting as slab edges; the pillars are side strips beside the panes, not slabs across them. THIRD PASS: mud-terrain tyres with a merged ring of twenty lugs, a glass tile keyed sill-to-top, black rail caps and a dark liner, body-colour mirrors, and the clean green authored down to the plate.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 1.87 x 1.79 x 5.30 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=8000 triangles, <=6 draw calls, <=4 materials, <=8 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot plus one named pivot per wheel (4); zero sockets; convex collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

specRefineTriggers: local feature not traceable to viewEvidence
codeRefineTriggers: spec is adequate but generated geometry/material does not match
lighting hides geometry or material response
stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: single-image extraction is reference-derived inference, not exact photogrammetry

mustAvoid: plastic-looking smooth bark, stone, cloth, foliage, or aged material
local color/detail described only in prose without material masks
claiming exact PBR recovery when confidence is below the target threshold
reference lighting copied without separating material readability

screenshotReview: Compare albedo palette and local color zones.
Compare cavity dirt, edge wear, stains, moss, scratches, or other local masks.
Compare key/fill/rim structure, exposure, tone mapping, background, and contact shadows.
Capture a neutral-light render to verify material readability without reference lighting.
Capture a grazing-light close-up to expose flat normals, uniform roughness, tiling, and plastic highlights.
Capture a reference-matched render from the same camera framing as the source.

silhouette.description: Sill 0.46 m, wheels 0.72 m in diameter at z +1.75 and -1.33 (3.08 wheelbase, 0.90 front overhang), nose face to 0.90 m then a 0.09 m lip arc onto a bonnet crowning 0.99-1.10 m to the scuttle at z 1.52, windscreen raked to z 1.14 at 1.68 m, 0.12 m roof-corner arcs front and rear, roof at 1.77 m to z -0.40, roof at 1.77 m to z -0.40, a full 0.12 m quarter-round into a vertical cab back at z -0.64, bed floor at 0.82 m, rails at 1.22 m, tailgate at z -2.60. silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -0.935..+0.935 on the shell (mirrors to +-1.04); y 0.00 to 1.77; z -2.65..+2.65 bumper to bumper, +Z forward. The Meshy proxy normalises to L:H:W = 1 : 0.341 : 0.363 -- 2.93 lengths tall, which AGREES with the declared 5.30 / 1.79 = 2.96 -- so every height is a proxy fraction of H and every station a fraction of L at the declared metres.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate normalises to L:H:W = 1 : 0.341 : 0.363, i.e. 5.30 x 1.81 x 1.92 m at the declared length -- within 2 percent of the registry on height and 3 percent on width. Side elevation (scratch/isuzu-d-max/_ev/side.png): roof 1.00 H, belt and rail 0.68 H, wheel top 0.40 H, sill 0.26 H; bonnet 0.03-0.27 L, cab roof 0.30-0.60 L, bed 0.60-0.98 L; axles 0.17 L and 0.75 L.

localOverrides.region: sills, lower doors, bed side and arches
localOverrides.evidence: Mud p85 #736953 at the front-door base and #635b4c on the bed side against the roof's #4d7953. A wash solid to the sill (0.46 m) fading out at 1.04 m, 220 spray streaks and 4,200 specks concentrated behind the front wheel, ahead of the rear arch and along the bed side (the plate's three heavy zones), a 0.12 dust film everywhere; roof and bonnet clean.

evidence: Clean paint measured on the plate roof (region-paint, PBR confidence 0.751) at #4d7953, rear door #4c6d50; the clean green authored #456c4a because the key-lit top faces render ~20 percent bright (hero #639666 against the plate). The mud (region-mud, p85 #736953) is authored as a pale tan #7a6e58 -- lifted a step because the wash sits on the flank the key light never reaches -- and is BRIGHTER than the green in every channel, so the material carries it as the envelope E and the canvas paints the clean green as ratio(clean, E) formed in linear space; the mud is the envelope itself.

Textureless as DECLARED: one 512 px Canvas 2D tile bound after material construction as map, fitted to the vehicle length in u (5.30 m) and 2 m in v; upward faces are keyed into the clean band of the tile.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.91. 7,296/8,000 triangles, 4/6 draw calls, 3/4 materials, 4/8 unique geometries, two canvases at 1.7 MB, factory ~80 ms. Colliders re-derived at the 0.045 voxel: 8 boxes, coverage 0.961.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the hero class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: 3 components and one repetition system: 4 of 6. The pillars ride the shell; every trim part rides one merge.

materials.note: paint, glass and a white vertex-coloured trim: 3 of 4. Tyres, rims, bumpers and lamps differ in albedo only.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 7,296 of 8,000: one extrusion with two 8-segment arches, a 20-segment wheel lathe, and boxes.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: A closed side-profile polygon extruded across the width and shaped per vertex (tumblehome above the belt, plan rounding at nose and tail); an offset extrusion of the cabin polygon for the glass; a lathe for the wheel; boxes for everything else.
One InstancedMesh carries the four wheels; the right-side instances are yawed a half turn so the dish faces out. No per-instance colour, so the white base is inert.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.

Every material is declared textureless. TWO Canvas 2D tiles are bound after construction: a 512 px mud tile as the paint map (clean paint as a linear-space ratio of the dust envelope, fitted to the length in u) and a 256 px sky-gradient glass tile as the glazing map. 1.7 MB of texture VRAM, factory ~80 ms.

risks.description: The tailgate face and rear lamps are built to type.
The bed liner is a warm #4e4438 / #3a3228 where the plate bed reads #252625.
risks.mitigation: A plum-black floor rendered the backdrop grey under the key light specular at 180 (a 212 x 19 px hole); the liner tones carry saturation 0.28-0.43 so the gate keeps them. Recorded on the material.
